findings.title: Brute-force spatial query defers the large-scale NFR target, per plan
findings.description: The architecture's "tens of thousands of agents at full behavioral fidelity" goal is not restated as a target in this slice, and the O(n²) brute-force build is scoped to "hundreds-of-agents scale." This is consistent with the plan (slice 105 replaces the implementation behind the unchanged interface) and the architecture explicitly permits a naive initial strategy, so no action is needed — but the slice correctly notes it must not be optimized here, and (105)'s determinism-preserved regression test covers the eventual swap.

findings.title: Environment input surface intentionally absent
findings.description: The architecture lists "Environment as input surface" as a principle, but the slice plan entry for (100) does not include environment queries, and no Environment Layer initiative exists yet. The slice's exclusion is correct proportionality, not a gap — no requirement in this slice's plan entry is left unmet by its absence.
